City Council

September 25, 2025

Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, and Building Standards
ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all of the B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-1 in an area bound by:

West Fullerton Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to North Campbell
Avenue; a line 96.61 feet south of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue; North
Campbell Avenue.

To those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in full force and effect immediately upon its

passage and publication.

Daniel Clits
Alderman, 18 Ward

Common Address: 2429 — 2431 West Fullerton Avenue
